name: binaryCofan_isColimit_iff
statement: TopCat} (c : BinaryCofan X Y) : Nonempty (IsColimit c) ↔ IsOpenEmbedding c.inl ∧ IsOpenEmbedding c.inr ∧ IsCompl (range c.inl) (range c.inr)

have_tree.type: ∀ x, x ∈ Set.range c.inl ∨ x ∈ Set.range c.inr

children.type: ∀ a, a ∉ Set.range c.inl → a ∈ Set.range c.inr
c.inr x ∈ Set.range c.inl ⊓ Set.range c.inr
